description: On the tabletop in front of you are a white bowl near the back center, a yellow tennis ball to the left, a smartphone lying near the middle-right, plus a donut and a Rubik’s cube on the right. The left hand stays mostly resting near the tennis ball while the right hand reaches in from the right to grasp the phone as a right-hand object, lifts it up and forward, then lowers and releases it so it ends up leaning inside the bowl; both hands then pull back.
